BUMBLES

Art credits

Dungeon floors and walls

Dungeon tileset by Buch · CC0. Selected tiles are drawn from the original atlas.

Wall torches

Lots of free 2d tiles and sprites by Hyptosis, submitted by Zabin · CC BY 3.0. The torch is drawn from batch 1.

Wall crystals

Kyrise's Free 16x16 RPG Icon Pack by Kyrise · CC BY 4.0. Crystals and the collectible helmet use original 16×16 icons.

Animated monsters and loot

Animated enemy sheets come from the player-supplied “Monster pack with multiple color” archive. Weapons and treasure crates come from the player-supplied “Dungeon Crawler tileset pack v1.5” archive.

Characters and items

Dungeon Crawl 32x32 tiles, maintained by Chris Hamons and submitted by MedicineStorm · CC0. The game animates selected sprites from this collection.
